verifiers.claim: A tool handler receives an effect bound to the admitted actor, thread and run; identifiers in the model's arguments grant nothing.
A path in a tool argument reaches only mounts the run's grants cover; a page command's input is checked against its schema and a page cannot answer another page's or actor's request.
Every tool call through the runtime lands in the receipt log attributed to actor, thread, run and tool.
File mutations commit with their receipt inside the provider's critical section and the run's receipt row names mount, path and both revisions.
One conformance suite passes against the memory, directory and GitHub providers; a provider that cannot honour a condition refuses instead of degrading.
The same suite passes against the HTTP file routes through their client; the session, never the request body, names the receipt's actor; a transport failure is unverified, never success.
A chat client reconnecting rebuilds the same transcript from the wire's cursor replay alone.

On the running example, the chat page rebuilds the same transcript after a reload, and the runs and thread replay unchanged after a restart of the app with its data kept: nothing shown was held by the page.

The tree holds only projections of list: a refresh rebuilds it from the provider, so a file the agent wrote appears at the revision its receipt names and nothing the tree showed before survives on its own.
The checker and registry loader reject what they must: forbidden imports, cycles, undeclared externals, duplicate or orphan laws, accidentally green verifiers.
Each of the four bounded models detects a removed guard per invariant (one mutant each); a syntax error is not a passing negative test; missing TLC fails.

The lint configuration refuses an import against the package direction (chat importing Flue, Node or the agent runtime; agent importing chat; files importing the repository or a runtime) and accepts the allowed edges.
Package imports follow the declared direction, including type-only edges and computed loading.
oxlint enforces the same direction at every import site with a message naming the law; the correctness category is clean.
The public contracts of the three packages typecheck together.
Definition loading validates front matter with errors naming the file and field; a registry never grants anything.
